# Third-party model files

This directory contains upstream-derived code and model artifacts used by
optional CRISPR scoring paths. Licenses, upstream URLs, versions, and file
hashes are recorded in `UPSTREAM-MANIFEST.json` and each component's license
file.

These files are not part of the core DNA editing or assembly algorithms. If a
future public distribution omits them, the corresponding model must report
`unavailable` rather than silently using a substitute.
